name: Carbonia (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and black, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carbonia (a miner's lamp on blue above black rock) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Carbonia, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Carbonia arms — miner's lamp on blue above black rock, crowned, within branches
